comments.selectedText:
#### RecurringTask
- **Purpose:** Base class for recurring scheduled tasks
- **Abstract Members:**
  - `Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)`: Task execution logic
- **Attributes:**
  - `[TaskName("...")]`: Override default task name
  - `[TaskDescription("...")]`: Provide task description
  - `[TaskKey("...")]`: Override default task key (TypeFullName)
  - `[MaxConcurrency(n)]`: Override global concurrency limit
  - `[RetryCount(n)]`: Override global retry count
  - `[MaxExecutionTimeout("hh:mm:ss")]`: Override execution timeout
  - `[CronSchedule("...")]`: Define cron expression
  - `[TaskStartTime("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")]`: Define start time
  - `[TaskEndTime("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")]`: Define end time
- **Dependencies:** Constructor supports DI

- `ModuleTaskSchedulerGuide EnableRecurringTaskDebugMode()`: Enable recurring debug mode
  - `ModuleTaskSchedulerGuide EnableTriggeredTaskDebugMode()`: Enable triggered debug mode
  - `ModuleTaskSchedulerGuide SetMaxWorkerThreads(int maxThreads)`: Configure thread limit
